audit.why: The spike structure of this lane is sharp and was under-described: your window is levels 1-3 with an 850-range Q against a 20s Alpha Strike, the swing is his level 6 at 85s, and the fourth genuine spike — Body Slam cancelling a 10s Meditate — was missing entirely. audit.whatIsWrong: Three decisive interactions appeared nowhere: Highlander grants immunity to all slowing effects; Meditate is a channel that any CC cancels; Alpha Strike makes him untargetable and its cooldown shortens with every basic attack.
audit.why: Slow immunity is the interaction that decides the lane after 6 — Barrel Roll's slow is Gragas' kiting tool and it simply stops functioning, while Body Slam's stun and Explosive Cask's knockback still land. That is the difference between 'he out-DPSes you' and knowing exactly which two buttons still work. Meditate's channel is the reverse: a 10s cooldown heal that your E deletes on reaction, and it is the concrete sequencing line the packet flagged as missing everywhere on this page. Alpha Strike's untargetability explains why a Cask timed onto his engage whiffs, and the attack-driven cooldown reduction means the 20s timer is shorter than it looks.
audit.corrected: Slow immunity written into whys[4], spikes[1] and mid; the Meditate interrupt into early, whys[3] and the new spikes[3]; both plus the untargetability into the new full-layer cooldown-facing fields.
